replies.author: @BestHiddenPlaces
replies.text: Thank you for telling us, and for watching as a Namibian. We never want a film about your country to feel unfair. Could you share which part bothered you? If we got something wrong or framed it badly, we'd really like to know so we can correct it here and do better next time. 🙏
